Delay Motor Stop
paramInformation.description: How long to wait before stopping the motor after reaching the end position

metadata.inclusion:
1. Press and hold the S button until the LED turns solid blue.
2. Release the button, then press and hold it again for more than 2 seconds until the blue LED starts blinking slowly.
3. Release the S button.
4. The blue LED blinks faster while adding. The green LED blinks slowly when the device was added successfully.
metadata.exclusion:
1. Press and hold the S button until the LED turns solid blue.
2. Release the button, then press and hold it again for more than 2 seconds until the blue LED starts blinking slowly.
3. Release the S button.
4. The blue LED blinks faster while removing. The blue LED blinks slowly when the device was removed successfully.
metadata.reset:
1. Press and hold the S button until the LED turns solid blue.
2. Press the S button repeatedly until the LED turns solid red.
3. Press and hold the S button for more than 2 seconds until the red LED starts blinking faster.
4. Release the S button.
5. The LED turns solid green for about 1 second, then the blue and red LEDs blink for about 2 seconds. The blue LED blinks slowly when the reset was successful.
